title: لا أنوي أن
form: I'm not going to + base verb

cells.en: I'm not going to drive tonight.
cells.description: Adult planning transport without driving

cells.en: I'm not going to skip breakfast.
cells.description: Adult preparing to keep breakfast in a routine

cells.en: I'm not going to buy a new laptop yet.
